listing.name: Dragon Ball Z: Burst Limit (DBZ Burst Limit Recompiled)
listing.summary: Register an independently permitted prepared Dragon Ball Z: Burst Limit Windows copy for your own exact US Xbox 360 disc, with external saves and upstream updates preserved.

steps.title: Complete the exact owned-disc preparation upstream
steps.instruction: Use a complete copy and components you are independently permitted to use. Supply your own US/NTSC-U Dragon Ball Z: Burst Limit Xbox 360 disc and complete matching data; default.xex is 7,983,104 bytes, SHA-1 aec598f88cf51181fc377b148e0b1ad30db4485c. European/PAL or Japanese images are not interchangeable. Complete the official first-run ISO selection/copy upstream before attachment; the original is not modified and full extracted game data remains required at runtime. Portcove does not acquire, extract, install or compile originals.

steps.title: Attach the supported prepared native entry
steps.instruction: Select burstlimit.exe with its complete Windows player folder as the working directory. Normal startup and Play need no extra arguments. Keep all matching SDK, runtime, graphics and upscaler DLLs, resources and notices together. The start screen and game run in the selected process, which waits for game execution to finish before requesting quit. Do not select an online helper, updater, build script or Linux Wine wrapper.

steps.instruction: The source can use game_data_root/ beside the executable when it contains default.xex, while an established game_data_root option/config may select elsewhere. steps.title: Keep upstream updates, restarts and online choices separate
steps.instruction: The upstream Update button can download and replace files, then restart the application. Finish updates outside a Portcove play session; Portcove does not track the restarted application as the selected player. Close all game instances and companion tools before replacing files. Keep the previous working runtime and data, then relink and review the changed executable. Configure online accounts, VPNs, routers and mod or save imports separately through upstream tools. Network and ranking features may use your Windows user name by default; keep identity and profile files private.

steps.title: Review Play and preserve every effective profile
steps.instruction: Review and consent to this exact executable, working directory and literal arguments, then request Play separately. Keep burstlimit.toml, game_data_root/, mods/, textures, sounds, any shader_seed and actual log/capture roots beside the creating player. The Windows SDK defaults user data to the actual Documents known folder/burstlimit, with user_data_root override; caches normally live below that user root unless overridden. Preserve saves, online_identity.json, export/import archives in the executable-adjacent saves/ folder, backups and every custom cache/update/metadata/user-data root. Do not assume the export folder contains every live save or that other runtimes have compatible state.

steps.title: Retain one external replacement owner
steps.instruction: Upstream and you retain preparation, runtime replacement/recovery and all external files. Removing registration preserves external files. Preserve the whole old creating runtime and all originals, settings, saves, mods, caches, logs and custom roots before maintenance; no external update, backup, rollback, migration or deletion is offered. Keep applicable SDK, NVIDIA/AMD, libjuice, controller-prompt and trophy-sound terms separately; code/framework labels do not license game assets or arbitrary components.

steps.title: Keep recovery copies outside startup cleanup paths
steps.instruction: Upstream owns cleanup during normal prepared startup, independently of choosing the Update button. EarlySetup calls BurstLimitUpdateCleanup on the executable directory: it removes update_staging immediately and deletes regular *.old files in the executable directory and licenses/, with deletion retries lasting up to 30 seconds. Before the first prepared startup, keep complete prior working runtimes and recovery backups outside those disposable *.old and update_staging paths. Preserve the actual original, saves, settings and custom roots separately. Portcove does not disable this cleanup, manage the upstream replacement, or promise preservation of files that upstream treats as disposable.
